_comment: Template project config. Copy to <yourproject>.json and edit. Run with: python cli.py -p <yourproject> full --all
name: template
description: Copy this file, rename it, and point the targets at your code.
_comment_targets: One entry per codebase. path must be ABSOLUTE. On a CI runner, generate this file at runtime rather than committing machine-specific paths - a path that does not resolve produces a scan of zero files that still reports success.
_comment_excludes: Directories never scanned. Vendored dependencies and build output produce findings you cannot fix and drown the ones you can.
_comment_plugins: Enable only what applies. A scanner listed but unavailable is reported as SKIPPED with its capability named, never silently omitted.
_comment_gate: Release gate thresholds. block_on_critical should stay true. min_score is a floor, not a target - set it where you are, then raise it.
_comment_dast: DAST target. MUST be a non-production host. The suite aborts if this matches a production endpoint.
_comment_compliance: Frameworks to map findings against in generated reports.
